channel.title: Emory Financial Insights
channel.description: Plain-English articles from California mortgage broker Derek Shao on homeownership, home equity, family property and the economy, and what each means for your mortgage.

item.title: Helping Your Adult Child Buy a Home: Gift, Co-Sign, or Co-Borrow?
item.description: Want to help your son or daughter buy in California? Compare a gift, co-signing and co-borrowing, with 2026 gift tax limits and what lenders require.

item.title: Divorce and the Family Home in California: Keep It, Sell It, or Buy Out Your Spouse?
item.description: Going through a divorce in California? How community property, spousal buyouts, Prop 13 and capital gains work, and how to refinance your ex off the loan.

item.title: Building an ADU in California: For Family or Rental Income, and How to Pay for It
item.description: Thinking about an ADU for your parents, your adult kids or rental income? California's 2026 ADU rules, how lenders count ADU rent, and the ways to finance one.

item.title: HELOC vs. Cash-Out Refinance: How to Tap Your Equity Without Giving Up a Low Rate
item.description: Half of U.S. homeowners have a mortgage rate under 4%. Here's when a HELOC beats a cash-out refinance, when it doesn't, and what the 2026 tax rules say.

item.title: Self-Employed and Planning to Buy? Start With Next Year's Tax Return
item.description: Write-offs that save you tax can shrink your mortgage. How lenders read self-employed tax returns, which deductions they add back, and a 12-month plan before you buy.

item.title: Worried About AI and Your Job? Here's What It Means for Your Mortgage
item.description: Worried AI could affect your job? A 20-year California mortgage broker explains what to do now to protect your home, your loan options, and your plans.

item.title: Earned Wage Access and Buying a Home: What Tradespeople and Gig Workers Should Know
item.description: Landscapers, electricians, pool techs and gig workers increasingly use pay-early apps. Here's how earned wage access shows up when you apply for a California mortgage.

item.title: Buy, Remodel, or Tear Down and Rebuild? A California Homeowner's Decision Guide
item.description: Outgrowing your home? Compare buying, remodeling and rebuilding in California, including property tax, financing options and a checklist to choose your path.

item.title: Inheriting Your Parents' California Home: Prop 19, Property Taxes, and Sibling Buyouts
item.description: Plan to keep your parents' California home? How Prop 19's $1,044,586 exclusion works, what it means for property tax, and how to finance a sibling buyout.

item.title: Should You Pay Off Your Mortgage Early or Invest the Difference?
item.description: Extra mortgage payments vs. investing: a California mortgage broker runs the numbers for 3% and 6.75% loans and shows how to decide what fits your family.
